labeller: Project author, with AI assistance, from the source PDFs, per eval/answer_keys/README.md. Labelled BEFORE any agent run on this case; HELD-OUT: a new equipment class the pipeline was not tuned on.
case_notes: The package merges two public Vertiv documents: the EXL S1 brochure (India edition, 2019: 400 V / 50 Hz, 14 pages) and the US site planning sheet SL-26092 (480 V, 3 pages). Pages 1-14 are the brochure, 15-17 the site planning sheet.

labels.notes: US site planning sheet lists the 1200 kVA / 1200 kW module at 480 VAC.
1200 kW is only available at 35 C; at 40 C the 1200 kVA unit gives 1080 kW (90%).

The package contradicts itself: the brochure (India edition) offers 400 V (380/415), 50 Hz with 60 Hz selectable and never 480 V; the US site planning sheet p15 says 480 VAC 3-wire plus ground. No configuration is marked as supplied.
US sheet: at least 96.3% at 100% rated load; brochure says up to 97%.
Input current distortion THDi <= 3% in the same table.
